cat_enabled.description: Enable Intel Cache Allocation Technology (CAT) support.

cmt_enabled.description: Enable Intel Cache Monitoring Technology (CMT) support.

cmt_interval_ms.description: Monitoring data sampling interval in milliseconds (e.g., 1000 = 1 second).

resctrl_path.description: Mount path for the resctrl filesystem (required for CAT/CMT control).

pid_map_path.description: Path to the runtime PID-to-COS mapping file used by the tool.

cos_groups.description: List of Cache Class of Service (COS) definitions for partitioning CPU cache and memory bandwidth.

id.description: Numeric ID for the COS (1–16 typically; must be unique).

cache_mask.description: Hexadecimal bitmask specifying allocated cache ways (e.g., '0xF0' = upper 4 of 8 ways).

memory_bandwidth.description: Percent of total memory bandwidth to allocate (if supported and desired).

l3_cache_ways.description: Alternative: number of L3 cache ways to allocate (integer). Overrides cache_mask if specified.

cpus.description: Optional CPU affinity (e.g., '0-3,8-11') to restrict processes in this COS to specific cores.

pid_mappings.description: Optional static or regex-based mappings from PID or process name to COS.

pattern.description: PID (numeric string) or regex pattern (e.g., '^nginx$') to match processes.

cos_id.description: COS ID to assign matching processes to.
